title: Security and Risk Management quick learning plan
principle: Start with why the organization is protecting something, who is accountable, and what evidence supports the decision. Learn technical controls later as treatments for these business decisions.

fast.method: Read each summary, speak the recall answers without notes, and use the scenario seed to choose the security-leader action before looking at supporting material.

standard.method: Complete every teaching section, example, recall check, and scenario seed. Revisit governance, risk, and continuity together because they share decision ownership and evidence.

sessions: Day 1: compare governance, policy, due care, and due diligence; redraw the risk treatment cycle from memory.
Day 4: work the continuity, threat-modeling, and supplier scenarios; state the missing artifact or decision owner.
Day 7: explain legal, investigation, personnel, and awareness choices as a leader-facing recommendation with a reason and evidence source.
